note: Three partition owners of variable 5 share the source name 'Svar' in one variant (#1736). The ladder's first step appends each owner's own operational definition; owner c carries a reviewed [[errata.field]] name, which wins over the ladder.
fails_if: the ladder stops appending the operational definition (a and b publish 'Svar' and are refused as duplicate_variable_name, or take a later step), or applies it over an explicit name correction (c becomes 'Svar — Alternativ C')

sources.description: Variable 5, named 'Svar', delivers A (CVID 21), B (CVID 22) and C (CVID 23) in edition 2020, with operational definitions 'Alternativ A', 'Alternativ B' and 'Alternativ C'.
